result:
I’d make it easier for people to genuinely understand one another across differences.

Not to force agreement—just to help people pause, see the world through someone else’s eyes, and recognize that their fears, hopes, and dignity are real before judging them. So many conflicts are worsened by turning other people into abstractions: enemies, stereotypes, or members of “the other side.”

That wouldn’t magically solve injustice or scarcity, but it would make cooperation, compromise, and kindness far more possible.
